Quick actions offer Request leave, Fill timesheet, Review approvals and Add new hire. Navigation offers Dashboard, Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, Approvals, Onboarding and My Profile.

The Directory click was refused before dispatch with Save after one intentional action. A following snapshot still showed /dashboard, browserActions 0, no API requests and no captures; Directory was not executed.
